intro: The UiPath MVP program looks at three things: technical expertise, community contribution and vision. Here is the evidence for each, with a link to where you can check it.

pillars.title: I · Technical expertise
pillars.summary: Hands-on UiPath depth since 2019, with production work across SAP and ServiceNow and a current focus on agentic automation.

rows.label: Current role
rows.value: Manager – Intelligent Process Automation, Capgemini Invent

pillars.title: II · Community contribution
pillars.summary: Daily forum help, a Pune chapter that meets in person, and talks on agentic automation.

rows.label: Product feedback
rows.value: Ideas posted for Studio and Orchestrator

pillars.title: III · Vision
pillars.summary: What I want to keep doing for the community.
points: Help developers move from RPA to agentic automation with practical, demo-first sessions on coded agents, MCP servers and Maestro.
Keep enterprise agents trustworthy: share patterns for governance, human-in-the-loop review and healing agents.
Grow the UiPath Pune chapter's in-person meetups and hands-on workshops.
Keep answering on the UiPath Forum and mentor people who are new to RPA.
